### 2026-10-18 – At this point, I realized my drone was not aerodynamically stable, so now I had to go through another wall of researching and designing everything. I asked Claude for help multiple times, and after ge

**6h**

At this point, I realized my drone was not aerodynamically stable, so now I had to go through another wall of researching and designing everything. I asked Claude for help multiple times, and after getting help from Claude and then checking the drone in a simulator, I came up with an idea of making one single drone as a part. Not particularly. I came up with the idea, but Claude came up with the idea. Claude is helping me build this drone dynamically stable so that I don't regret my first drone project. The graphs of the simulation came around 4 hours late. Then they had to come, so my work was getting postponed and postponed. After the simulation graphs came, I could decide where to put the load and where not to put the load. I'll attach the graphs in these images.
